market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver's all-time high is ~$50/oz, and current price is ~$30. Reaching $120 by mid-2026 would require a 4x surge in under two years—far beyond any plausible fundamental or speculative scenario given industrial demand, above‐ground inventories, and the historical volatility ceiling. The likelihood is effectively zero, so the 6.6% market price vastly overestimates the true probability.
evidence_points: Silver’s nominal record high is ~$50/oz (1980, 2011); $120 would be 2.4× that peak.
Silver currently trades near $30–$35; a 4× gain in ~2 years has never occurred in the modern era.
CME SI futures settlement data show no sustained move exceeding 100% annual returns without a severe monetary crisis, which remains a tail risk.
sources_consulted: CME Group historical settlement prices for Silver futures
